why: Expo Exact does not build Android on a Windows host yet. windows.patch carries the fixes reported upstream (expo/exact issues 147, 148, 149, 150; the line-ending one is handled by cloning with core.autocrlf=false) plus EXACT_GRADLE_ARGS, so the builder can pass its init script (shared signing key, versionCode). Drop the patch and move the pin once upstream has them.
